sloka: तथा अहम् धर्म नित्यस्य धर्म पत्नी दृढ व्रता ।त्वया संप्रष्टुम् न शक्या अहम् राक्षसाधम पापिना ॥३-५६-१९॥
transliteration: tathā aham dharma nityasya dharma patnī dṛḍha vratā ।tvayā saṁpraṣṭum na śakyā aham rākṣasādhama pāpinā ॥3-56-19॥

translations.english: O lowly demon similarly I am a chaste woman and wife of the ever righteous Rama who cannot be defiled by a sinner like you.
